You are provided with the following: <txt_content> {INPUT_CONTENT} </txt_content>
This is the content of a text file generated from a PDF on {TOPIC}. You need to convert this content into a LaTeX file.
You are also provided with a sample LaTeX file in the desired style: <sample_tex> {SAMPLE_TEX} </sample_tex>
Use this sample as a reference for the formatting, style, and structure of the LaTeX code you will generate.
The document class and custom commands for the LaTeX file are as follows: <document_class> {DOCUMENT_CLS_CONTENT} </document_class>
<command> {COMMAND_CONTENT} </command>
Additionally, here's an example of a research paper and its corresponding lecture note:
<example_paper> {EXAMPLE_PAPER} </example_paper>
<example_lecture_note> {EXAMPLE_LECTURE_NOTE} </example_lecture_note>
Use this example to guide your conversion from the research paper to lecture notes format.
